items.title: 30.4.2 High-resolution 1H NMR aur peaks ka batna (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of high-resolution 1H NMR and splitting (PDF 207-209).

blocks.text: NMR signals par sirf qareebi electrons nahi balke saath wale atoms ke protons bhi asar karte hain. High-resolution spectrum mein har peak aksar sub-peaks ka jhurmat hoti hai, kyunke signal saath wale carbon atoms ke protons (1H) se bat jata hai. Kai peaks (doublets, triplets, quartets) mein batna parosi carbon atom ke protons ki tadaad dikhata hai. Sub-peaks ki tadaad n + 1 rule par chalti hai: signal aam taur par n + 1 sub-peaks mein bat'ta hai, jahan n saath wale carbon atoms ke protons ki tadaad hai.

Ethanol ke high-resolution spectrum mein -CH3 peak teen sub-peaks (triplet) mein bat'ti hai, kyunke saath wale carbon par 2 protons hain (2 + 1 = 3), aur -CH2- peak chaar sub-peaks (quartet) mein, kyunke us ke saath wale carbon par 3 protons hain (3 + 1 = 4). -OH signal nahi bat'ta, kyunke is ka hydrogen carbon ki bajaye oxygen se jura hai. -OH aur -NH protons aam taur par nahi bat'te aur singlets ki shakal mein aate hain. Chemically equivalent protons bhi aik doosre ko nahi baant'te: ethane, CH3-CH3, aik na bati peak deta hai, kyunke is ke tamam hydrogens barabar hain.

blocks.caption: Aam batne ke namoone (kitab ka Table 30.2)

blocks.alt: Chaar panel: aik lakeer (singlet, koi parosi proton nahi); do barabar lakeerein (doublet, aik parosi, 1:1); teen lakeerein jin ki beech wali dugni oonchi (triplet, do parosi, 1:2:1); chaar lakeerein jin ki beech wali do bairooni se teen guna oonchi (quartet, teen parosi, 1:3:3:1).
blocks.caption: Batne ke namoone aur n + 1 rule (Table 30.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Signal agle carbon ke protons se bat'ta hai. Aik parosi do lakeerein, do parosi teen lakeerein aur teen parosi chaar lakeerein dete hain, unchaiyan dikhaye gaye tanasub mein.

blocks.prompt: 1H NMR spectrum mein aik signal quartet hai. Kitne saath wale, barabar protons hain?
(i) butan-2-ol, (ii) 1-chloropropane, (iii) propanone, (iv) 2,2-dimethylpropane, (v) methanol ke har signal ke sub-peaks batayein.
blocks.explanation: (i) CH3CH(OH)CH2CH3: C1 CH3 doublet; C2 H chhe sub-peaks (5 parosi); CH2 paanch sub-peaks (4 parosi); C4 CH3 triplet; OH singlet. (ii) ClCH2CH2CH3: CH2Cl triplet; beech wala CH2 chhe sub-peaks (5 parosi); CH3 triplet. (iii) Propanone: aik singlet. (iv) 2,2-dimethylpropane: aik singlet. (v) Methanol: CH3 singlet aur OH singlet.

items: n + 1 rule: saath wale carbon ke n protons n + 1 sub-peaks dete.
OH aur NH aam taur par singlets; barabar protons aik doosre ko nahi baant'te.
